title: ProtvistaViewerConfig
description: Declarative configuration for a ProtVista viewer instance (v1). Source-of-truth JSON Schema, authored in lockstep with src/schema/types.ts.

version.description: Schema protocol version. Optional — defaults to "1.0" when omitted.

extends.description: One or more base configs to merge under this one. Each entry is a URL, a file path, or a registered preset name resolved via an embedder-supplied resolver.

accession.description: Primary accession (e.g. "P05067"). Used to interpolate {accession} placeholders.

sources.description: Map of named URL templates. Tracks reference these by key.

strict.description: Promote every non-fatal warning (empty sequence, per-track fetch failure, setTrackData misuse) to a mount-level failure shown in the viewer's error panel. Default false.

rows.description: Ordered list of rows: each is either a group of tracks (has `tracks`) or a standalone track (has `data`, no `tracks`). Mixed freely; declaration order preserved.

TopLevelEntry.description: A group of tracks (has `tracks`) or a standalone track (has `data`, no `tracks`).

ConfigDefaults.description: Viewer-wide defaults inherited by every group/track.

label.description: Human-readable label. A Markdoc inline source string — Markdown (emphasis, code, links) plus the `{% help slug="…" %}…{% /help %}` tag; `{accession}` is interpolated before rendering. Block-level markup is not supported. Falls back to a title-cased form of `id` if omitted.

description.description: Short plain-text description shown as a native tooltip (HTML `title` attribute) when hovering the group label. No Markdown or HTML interpretation.

label.description: Human-readable label. A Markdoc inline source string — Markdown (emphasis, code, links) plus the `{% help slug="…" %}…{% /help %}` tag; `{accession}` is interpolated before rendering. Block-level markup is not supported. Falls back to a title-cased form of `id` if omitted.

data.description: String shorthand, single descriptor, or array of descriptors.

description.description: Short plain-text description shown as a native tooltip (HTML `title` attribute) when hovering the track label. No Markdown or HTML interpretation.

DataTooltip.description: Per-item tooltip. Three authoring forms: (a) a bare string — shorthand for a Markdoc template; (b) a fields object — declarative label/value rows; (c) a template object — explicit Markdoc template with optional extra variables. Rich, interactive, or stateful tooltips are not a config concern — listen for the Nightingale `change` event and mount your own UI, setting `notooltip` on the element to suppress the built-in popover.

TooltipFieldsSpec.description:
Declarative label/value rows. Each entry becomes `
label
` followed by the HTML-escaped value at `path`. Rich / interactive / stateful tooltips are not a config concern — consumers listen for the Nightingale `change` event, mount their own UI, and set `notooltip` on the element to suppress the built-in popover.

TooltipFieldSpec.description:
One row in a `fields`-form tooltip. `path` is a dotted property path against the item (e.g. `association.0.name`). The value at `path` is coerced to string, HTML-escaped, and wrapped in `

` at the leaf.

TooltipMarkdownSpec.description: Markdoc template rendered against the item's fields. `{% $field %}` interpolates scalars.

variables.description: Extra variables merged into the Markdoc scope alongside the item's fields. Useful for threading track-level context (accession, trackId) into per-item templates.

DataSourceDescriptor.description: Bridge between Intent and Representation. `from` defaults to "url".

ColorScaleConfig.description: Either a named theme OR explicit stops (at least one required). When both are present, explicit stops take precedence at render time.

SemanticKind.description: Open-string vocabulary. Closed-set validation (built-ins + runtime-registered kinds) is applied by the runtime validator, not this static schema.

ComponentName.description: Open-string vocabulary. Closed-set validation is applied by the runtime validator.

AdapterName.description: Open-string vocabulary. Closed-set validation is applied by the runtime validator.
